interval_policy: Local constrained likelihood projection chi2_1 candidate; no inherited calibration guarantee; local null leakage -> R
shared_target: Reference environment or prespecified subgroup; no mean-generator interpretation

bootstrap_audit.endpoint: Within-environment point-estimate sign stability; audit only, not new patient or 500-replicate validation

deviations: Likelihood intervals use constrained local extrema rather than G2 fixed grids; independent evaluation required and all results remain exploratory.
No arbitrary mismatch envelope from additive epsilon+eta; coefficient and log-rate units kept separate.
Biological source attribution remains prohibited from residuals.
